C.label_methodology: Operator-provided operating-mode codes plus service reports; same derivation method as Farm B, distinct from Farm A's logbook-based labels (per Gueck & Roelofs 2024).

A.label_methodology: EDP fault logbook: explicit onset timestamp per event, curated by the site operator from SCADA alarms and maintenance records.

B.label_methodology: Operator-provided operating-mode codes plus service reports; onset inferred from mode-code transitions, not a single curated timestamp (per Gueck & Roelofs 2024).
